data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate's incurred claims, net of reinsurance, from past accident years developed favourably by $0.3 million during year (favourably by $0.5 million in 2014). This positive development of run-off losses during the year reflects loss reserve reductions on past catastrophes, particularly Superstorm Sandy.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Loss reserve reductions on past catastrophes resulted in favourable development of run-off losses

named_events.loss_description: loss reserve reductions on past catastrophes, particularly Superstorm Sandy

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were 9.132m (thousands shown in the accounts). During 2015 there was a very small prior-year release on gross claims (approximately $3k favourable). The managing agent reports this as part of favourable run-off on past accident years, attributing the improvement principally to loss reserve reductions on past catastrophes (notably Superstorm Sandy). The gross claims outstanding increased overall by class (notably in property), but the quantified movement specifically attributable to prior years is a small release.
raw_causal_phrases: developed favourably by $0.3 million during year
loss reserve reductions on past catastrophes, particularly Superstorm Sandy

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Numbers in the financial statements are presented in $000. All primary reserve figures were read from the gross Technical Provisions table (Claims outstanding) and the 'Claims incurred during the year related to: Prior underwriting years' row in the Technical Provisions note. The prior-year movement gross figure is very small (-$3k) while the narrative quotes a net favourable development of $0.3m. A gross claims development triangle is present (pages 49-50) and was used for cross-checking. Some narrative figures are net of reinsurance - the prior_year_development_gbp_m provided is the GROSS figure from the movement table.
